description:
`evals/eval/v1`: a question about some subjects, how it is tested, what
it rests on, and what was concluded. A `concluded` eval has a `verdict`.

decision.description: The decision the eval informed, once it is recorded.

informs.description: The choice the eval informs, in words, such as "whether PR 26 merges".

mounts.description:
The mount of each repository the eval concerns, such as
`/repos/crumbkit`.

runs.description: The runs its verdict rests on.

subjects.description:
What is tested: each a repository as `owner/name`, such as
`clap-rs/clap`, or a board path, without versions, which go in a
run's `versions`. A repository the board mounts is named by its mount
in `mounts` too.

suites.description: The suites that say how the eval is tested.

written_by.description:
The plugin and hook that wrote this record, such as runs/test-run;
absent when an agent or a person wrote it.

title: EvalRecord
